name: Archangel

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Increased Toxicity
The Neurotoxin coating Archangel's wings and claws increases in toxicity, making each Neurotoxin Passive reduce the Opponent's Ability Accuracy by [25 - 40]% and preventing them from gaining Health.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Archangel's personal Abilities cannot have their Ability Accuracy reduced.

abilitySections.title: Neurotoxin - Passive
content: Each time Archangel triggers a Bleed effect on an opponent with an active Poison effect that he caused, they are combined, converting into a Neurotoxin charge, lasting 15 seconds.
Neurotoxins are a Passive effect, and therefore do not count as either a Debuff, or a Poison.
Neurotoxins do [29,919] damage over their duration.
On expiry Neurotoxins have a 100% Chance to Stun their target for 1.5 seconds. This effect will not interrupt a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: Critical Hits lacerate opponents with a 40% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [12,466.25] damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 50% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [12,466.25 Direct Damage over 15 seconds.
Only the first Bleed effect triggered by this attack will consume a Poison effect, though all Bleeds triggered by it will convert to Neurotoxins as long as a Poison was consumed during the attack.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Each Bleed Debuff on your opponent increases the chance of any of Poison triggering by a flat 25%, and reduces the chance that an opponent's Purify abilities will trigger by the same.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: 0% chance on contact to Poison the target, reducing their Health recovery by 30% and dealing [12,466.25] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 20% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [12,466.25] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.
0% chance to Poison the target, reducing their Health recovery by 30% and dealing [12,466.25] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 50% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [12,466.25] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.
40% chance to Poison the target, reducing their Health recovery by 30% and dealing [12,466.25] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to Poison the target, reducing their Health recovery by 30% and dealing [12,466.25] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.
100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [12,466.25] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Increased Toxicity
content: The Neurotoxin coating Archangel's wings and claws increases in toxicity, making each Neurotoxin Passive reduce the Opponent's Ability Accuracy by [25 - 40]% and preventing them from gaining Health.
